definitions.meaning: To commit guilt or sin, to be guilty

source_text: gyltan; p. gylte; pp. gylt To commit guilt or sin, to be guilty :-- Ðara gyltendra scylda the sins of the guilty, Past. 21; Swt. 167, 6; Hat. MS. [Orm. gilltenn: Wicl. gilten: O. E. Homl. gulte; p.] v. gylting, gyltend, a-, for-gyltan.
